parts.name: plate 0

physics.Basic_description: Yellow painted metal plates forming the main rectangular housing of the lock body with visible layering.
physics.Functional_description: Encases the internal locking mechanism and provides structural integrity to the lock body.
physics.Grasped_description: A parallel jaw gripper would grasp the flat sides of the yellow body firmly to stabilize the object.
physics.reason: The body is a stamped or cast metal shell enclosing an air cavity and internal mechanism, not a solid block of steel.

physics.Functional_description: Secure the layered plates of the lock body together permanently.

parts.name: keyway disc

physics.Basic_description: Blue-colored circular disc surrounding the keyhole on the lock face.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a wear plate or dust cover interface for the key cylinder.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; too small and recessed for reliable gripping.
physics.reason: Likely a thin solid metal washer or disc component.

parts.description: Blue-colored circular disc surrounding the keyhole on the lock face.
parts.function: Acts as a wear plate or dust cover interface for the key cylinder.

parts.name: keyway slot

physics.Basic_description: Small yellow rectangular slot indicator above the keyhole.
physics.Functional_description: Visual indicator or part of the key insertion guide mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Not graspable due to size and location.
physics.reason: Small solid detail or cutout feature in the metal plate.

parts.description: Small yellow rectangular slot indicator above the keyhole.

parts.name: hinge bracket

physics.Basic_description: Orange-tinted structural element at the base of the shackle entry point (inferred from segmentation list, visually part of body assembly).
physics.Functional_description: Reinforces the area where the shackle enters the lock body.
physics.Grasped_description: Part of the main body grasp, not isolated.
physics.reason: Likely a solid reinforcement pin or bracket component within the assembly.

parts.description: Orange-tinted structural element at the base of the shackle entry point (inferred from segmentation list, visually part of body assembly).
parts.function: Reinforces the area where the shackle enters the lock body.

parts.name: shackle bar

physics.Basic_description: Long, white/silver U-shaped or straight bar extending from the lock body, appearing textured or coated.
physics.Functional_description: The locking element that passes through the hasp or chain to secure the equipment.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper could grasp the long span of the shackle bar to lift or manipulate the lock if the body is inaccessible.
physics.reason: Shackles are solid hardened steel rods designed to resist cutting and pulling forces.

parts.description: Long, white/silver U-shaped or straight bar extending from the lock body, appearing textured or coated.
parts.function: The locking element that passes through the hasp or chain to secure the equipment.

parts.name: cover flap

physics.Basic_description: Cyan-colored small flap hanging from the bottom of the lock body ends.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the keyway or shackle entry from dust and debris when not in use.
physics.Grasped_description: Too flimsy and small to grasp reliably; would deform under grip force.
physics.reason: Thin flexible plastic sheet, effectively solid for mass calculation purposes though very light.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
